criteria.label: First useful session from real notes
Focused practice and useful next step
Honest recovery from missing or weak sources
Phone, keyboard, themes and reduced motion

assessments.note: Correct, incorrect and unsure sample feedback showed the supported answer and exact inline source passage. Real-file/page navigation and cross-subject grading remain unverified.
Optional sample works before import, but this does not establish a first useful session from real notes.
Sample completed and returned to an updated plan. The long feedback/result layouts could be simpler; next-day recall and independent student success are untested.
Sample explicitly discloses its missing original PDF. No unsupported/scanned/multi-file recovery journey was tested.

Phone/desktop had no horizontal overflow; light/dark were visually legible; one keyboard focus outline verified. Completion targets corrected from 36px to measured 52px. Full focus order, measured contrast, screen-reader support and motion timing remain unverified.
Return to Today updated the same-browser sample. No authenticated cross-device or progress-loss test was performed.
Official page describes source-grounded responses and user-controlled sources. This is not a measured accuracy or locator test.
Official page lists flashcards, quizzes, mind maps and overviews. Hands-on friction and learning outcomes are untested.
Practice Tests accept uploaded or pasted notes and flashcard sets. Subscription, age, language and region restrictions are documented; check the current account's eligibility.
Question count, type and timer are configurable, followed by score/review. No inference about explanation quality or exact evidence navigation.
Reader documentation describes linked highlights/references that jump to their PDF locations. Actual locator fidelity has not been compared.
Reader combines PDF, notes and learning tools; Guided Learn Mode describes summaries, flashcards and quizzes. This does not establish superior or inferior usability.
